53: 		this.key = key;
54: 		this.nonNullAnnotation = nonNullAnnotation;
55: 		this.nullableAnnotation = nullableAnnotation;
56: 		this.typeUse = typeUse;
57: 	}

60: 	 * Returns the fully qualified annotation name to apply to non-null elements. If {@code null} is returned, apply no annotation.

74: 	 * If {@code true}, the annotation can only be used in TYPE_USE form, otherwise, prefer to annotate the parameter, not the type of the parameter (or the method, not the return type, etc).

83: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary JETBRAINS = new NullAnnotationLibrary("jetbrains", "org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull", "org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable", false);
84: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary NETBEANS = new NullAnnotationLibrary("netbeans", "org.netbeans.api.annotations.common.NonNull", "org.netbeans.api.annotations.common.NullAllowed", false);
85: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary ANDROIDX = new NullAnnotationLibrary("androidx", "androidx.annotation.NonNull", "androidx.annotation.Nullable", false);
86: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary ANDROID_SUPPORT = new NullAnnotationLibrary("android.support", "android.support.annotation.NonNull", "android.support.annotation.Nullable", false);
87: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary CHECKERFRAMEWORK = new NullAnnotationLibrary("checkerframework", "org.checkerframework.checker.nullness.qual.NonNull", "org.checkerframework.checker.nullness.qual.Nullable", true);
88: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary FINDBUGS = new NullAnnotationLibrary("findbugs", "edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull", "edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable", false);
89: 	public static final NullAnnotationLibrary SPRING = new NullAnnotationLibrary("spring", "org.springframework.lang.NonNull", "org.springframework.lang.Nullable", false);

92: 	private static final List<NullAnnotationLibrary> ALL_AVAILABLE;
93: 	private static final String EXAMPLE_VALUE;
94: 	
95: 	static {
96: 		ArrayList<NullAnnotationLibrary> out = new ArrayList<NullAnnotationLibrary>();
97: 		StringBuilder example = new StringBuilder();
98: 		for (Field f : NullAnnotationLibrary.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
99: 			if (f.getType() != NullAnnotationLibrary.class || !Modifier.isStatic(f.getModifiers()) || !Modifier.isPublic(f.getModifiers())) continue;
100: 			try {
101: 				NullAnnotationLibrary nal = (NullAnnotationLibrary) f.get(null);
102: 				out.add(nal);
103: 				example.append(nal.key).append(" | ");
104: 			} catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
105: 				continue;
106: 			}
107: 		}
108: 		out.trimToSize();

112: 	}

114: 	public static NullAnnotationLibrary custom(String nonNullAnnotation, String nullableAnnotation, boolean typeUse) {
115: 		if (nonNullAnnotation == null && nullableAnnotation == null) return NONE;
116: 		String typeUseStr = typeUse ? "TYPE_USE:" : "";
117: 		if (nullableAnnotation == null) return new NullAnnotationLibrary("custom:" + typeUseStr + nonNullAnnotation, nonNullAnnotation, null, typeUse);
118: 		if (nonNullAnnotation == null) return new NullAnnotationLibrary("custom::" + typeUseStr + nullableAnnotation, null, nullableAnnotation, typeUse);
119: 		return new NullAnnotationLibrary("custom:" + typeUseStr + nonNullAnnotation + ":" + nullableAnnotation, nonNullAnnotation, nullableAnnotation, typeUse);
120: 	}

122: 	public static String description() {

124: 	}

130: 	public static NullAnnotationLibrary valueOf(String in) {
131: 		String ci = in == null ? "" : in.toLowerCase();
132: 		if (ci.length() == 0) return NONE;
133: 		for (NullAnnotationLibrary nal : ALL_AVAILABLE) if (nal.key.equals(ci)) return nal;
134: 		if (!ci.startsWith("custom:")) {
135: 			StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("Invalid null annotation library. Valid options: ");
136: 			for (NullAnnotationLibrary nal : ALL_AVAILABLE) out.append(nal.key).append(", ");
137: 			out.setLength(out.length() - 2);
138: 			out.append(" or CUSTOM:[TYPE_USE:]nonnull.annotation.type:nullable.annotation.type");
139: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(out.toString());
140: 		}
141: 		boolean typeUse = ci.startsWith("custom:type_use:");
142: 		int start = typeUse ? 16 : 7;
143: 		int split = ci.indexOf(':', start);
144: 		if (split == -1) {
145: 			String nonNullAnnotation = in.substring(start);
146: 			return custom(verifyTypeName(nonNullAnnotation), null, typeUse);
147: 		}

149: 		String nullableAnnotation = in.substring(split + 1);
150: 		return custom(verifyTypeName(nonNullAnnotation), verifyTypeName(nullableAnnotation), typeUse);
151: 	}

153: 	private static final String MSG = "Not an identifier (provide a fully qualified type for custom: nullity annotations): ";
154: 	private static String verifyTypeName(String fqn) {
155: 		boolean atStart = true;
156: 		for (int i = 0; i < fqn.length(); i++) {
157: 			char c = fqn.charAt(i);
158: 			if (Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(c)) {
159: 				atStart = false;
160: 				continue;
161: 			}
162: 			if (atStart) throw new IllegalArgumentException(MSG + fqn);
163: 			if (c == '.') {
164: 				atStart = true;
165: 				continue;
166: 			}
167: 			if (Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(c)) continue;
168: 			throw new IllegalArgumentException(MSG + fqn);
169: 		}
170: 		if (atStart) throw new IllegalArgumentException(MSG + fqn);
171: 		return fqn;

174: 	public void applyToMethodDecl(JavacTreeMaker maker, JCMethodDecl method, JCAnnotation annotation) {
175: 		if (annotation == null || method == null) return;
176: 		String libraryKey = this.key;
177: 		if (libraryKey == null) return;
178: 		boolean typeUse = this.typeUse;
179: 		JCModifiers mods = method.mods;
180: 		JCExpression resType = method.restype;
181: 		Name methodName = method.name;
182: 		if (typeUse) {
183: 			if (methodName != null && methodName.contentEquals("<init>") && resType == null) return;
184: 			if (resType instanceof JCTypeApply) {
185: 				JCTypeApply parameterized = (JCTypeApply) resType;
186: 				JCExpression clazz = parameterized.clazz;
187: 				com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCExpression> arguments = parameterized.arguments;
188: 				if (clazz instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
189: 					method.restype = maker.TypeApply(maker.AnnotatedType(com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation), clazz), arguments);
190: 					return;
191: 				}
192: 				resType = clazz;
193: 			}
194: 			if (resType instanceof JCFieldAccess || resType instanceof JCArrayTypeTree) {
195: 				method.restype = maker.AnnotatedType(com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation), resType);
196: 				return;
197: 			}
198: 			if (isAnnotatedType(resType)) {
199: 				JCExpression underlying = getAnnotatedUnderlyingType(resType);
200: 				com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> typeAnnotations = getAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(resType);
201: 				if (underlying == null && typeAnnotations == null) return;
202: 				if (typeAnnotations == null) typeAnnotations = com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.nil();
203: 				setAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(resType, typeAnnotations.prepend(annotation));
204: 				return;
205: 			}
206: 			if (resType instanceof JCPrimitiveTypeTree || resType instanceof JCIdent) {
207: 				com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> existing = mods.annotations;
208: 				mods.annotations = existing == null ? com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation) : existing.prepend(annotation);
209: 			}
210: 		} else {
211: 			com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> existing = mods.annotations;
212: 			mods.annotations = existing == null ? com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation) : existing.prepend(annotation);
213: 		}
214: 	}

216: 	public void applyToVarDecl(JavacTreeMaker maker, JCVariableDecl variable, JCAnnotation annotation) {
217: 		if (annotation == null || variable == null) return;
218: 		boolean typeUse = this.typeUse;
219: 		if (typeUse) {

221: 			JCTypeApply parameterized = null;
222: 			if (varType instanceof JCTypeApply) {
223: 				parameterized = (JCTypeApply) varType;
224: 				varType = parameterized.clazz;
225: 			}
226: 			if (varType instanceof JCFieldAccess || varType instanceof JCArrayTypeTree) {
227: 				varType = maker.AnnotatedType(com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation), varType);
228: 				if (parameterized != null) parameterized.clazz = varType;
229: 				else variable.vartype = varType;
230: 				return;
231: 			}
232: 			if (isAnnotatedType(varType)) {
233: 				com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> typeAnnotations = getAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(varType);
234: 				setAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(varType, typeAnnotations.prepend(annotation));
235: 				return;
236: 			}
237: 			if (varType instanceof JCPrimitiveTypeTree || varType instanceof JCIdent) {
238: 				com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> existing = variable.mods.annotations;
239: 				variable.mods.annotations = existing == null ? com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation) : existing.prepend(annotation);
240: 			}
241: 		} else {
242: 			com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> existing = variable.mods.annotations;
243: 			variable.mods.annotations = existing == null ? com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.of(annotation) : existing.prepend(annotation);
244: 		}
245: 	}

247: 	private static Class<?> annotatedTypeClass;
248: 	private static Field annotatedTypeAnnotations;
249: 	private static Field annotatedTypeUnderlying;
250: 
251: 	private static void initAnnotatedType(Class<?> type) {
252: 		if (annotatedTypeClass != null) return;
253: 		if (type == null || !"com.sun.tools.javac.tree.JCTree$JCAnnotatedType".equals(type.getName())) return;
254: 		try {
255: 			annotatedTypeAnnotations = Permit.getField(type, "annotations");
256: 			annotatedTypeUnderlying = Permit.getField(type, "underlyingType");
257: 			annotatedTypeClass = type;
258: 		} catch (Exception ignore) {}
259: 	}

261: 	private static boolean isAnnotatedType(JCTree tree) {
262: 		if (tree == null) return false;
263: 		initAnnotatedType(tree.getClass());
264: 		return tree.getClass() == annotatedTypeClass;
265: 	}

267: 	@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
268: 	private static com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> getAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(JCTree tree) {

272: 		} catch (Exception e) {
273: 			return com.sun.tools.javac.util.List.nil();
274: 		}
275: 	}

277: 	private static void setAnnotatedTypeAnnotations(JCTree tree, com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<JCAnnotation> annotations) {
278: 		initAnnotatedType(tree.getClass());
279: 		try {
280: 			annotatedTypeAnnotations.set(tree, annotations);
281: 		} catch (Exception ignore) {}
282: 	}

284: 	private static JCExpression getAnnotatedUnderlyingType(JCTree tree) {
285: 		initAnnotatedType(tree.getClass());
286: 		try {
287: 			return (JCExpression) annotatedTypeUnderlying.get(tree);
288: 		} catch (Exception e) {
289: 			return null;
290: 		}

Done. The fix adds Jakarta annotation support in two places:

1. **`src/core/lombok/core/configuration/NullAnnotationLibrary.java:82`** — added a `JAKARTA` library constant (`jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` / `jakarta.annotation.Nullable`), so `lombok.addNullAnnotations = jakarta` works like `javax`.

2. **`src/core/lombok/core/handlers/HandlerUtil.java`** — added `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` to `NONNULL_ANNOTATIONS` (so generated setters/constructors/builder params produce null checks) and `jakarta.annotation.CheckForNull`, `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull`, `jakarta.annotation.Nullable` to `BASE_COPYABLE_ANNOTATIONS` (so these annotations on fields are copied to generated setters, with-ers, and `@Builder` setter methods — the exact scenario in the issue).

Validation via `ant test.instance` in the container:
- `NullLibrary3` delombok tests (which use `lombok.addNullAnnotations = jakarta`) now pass — previously failing.
- Remaining 4 failures (`BuilderSingularOnRecord`, `FieldNameConstantsOnRecord`, `WithByOnRecordComponent`, `WithOnRecordComponent`) are pre-existing at baseline and unrelated to this change.
